Play the Centipede Game

You'll be taking on the role of Mutt (Player 1). Just play this as you naturally would, without overanalyzing it, the backward induction comes later. And don't assume the other player (Jeff) is necessarily playing an optimal strategy either.

The game will skip ahead to round 97 after round 2. So don't worry, you won't be clicking through every round! Remember, the game ends either when both plays get to $100, or as soon as someone defects (steals from the other).
